changes: Extended the SDC calendar-year offer window from 1981-1990 through 1995, keeping the original 1981 start and rebuilding the full pooled period from current local source vintages.

Shifted dependent source bounds only as required by the accepted construction: I/B/E/S ANNDATS through 1996-03-31, Compustat FYEAR through 2000, and CRSP MSF/MSI monthly dates through 2001-03-31. The -9/+3-month forecast window, offer-year-to-offer-year+5 earnings fit, +4 through +63 CRSP month offsets, complete-case intersection, estimator and system restrictions are unchanged.
Added native counts from the active Stata e(sample), using offer_year retained in the SAS-to-Stata handoff. The sample declaration was frozen at 1981-1995 before the controller run.
limitations: The SDC BFO underwriting indicator is missing on all 7,114 U.S. Public Common Shares candidates in the original 1981-1990 period and on all 5,203 added-period candidates. The 12,317-offer pooled source universe therefore remains a public/common-share best effort; the paper’s original-period starting pool is 7,636 offers and local records do not establish an underwriting or rights-offering screen.

The original-period complete-case sample remains 818 offers versus the paper’s Table 7 N=1,179. The fresh pooled sample has 1,630 offers, comprising 818 original-period and 812 added-period complete cases; the inherited discrepancy is not resolved by the extension.

The paper does not report the equation-error covariance or weighting matrix. The accepted reconstruction uses a direct Gaussian mlexp likelihood with separate variances and independent equation errors to identify the recursive system; treat the Table 7 structural estimates and LR tests as best effort under that assumption.

The realized-growth start-year description conflicts between physical pp. 14 and 26. The accepted code follows the Table 7 note and uses offer year through offer year+5. The paper also omits the exact log base and slope-to-annualized-growth conversion.

The paper specifies five-year buy-and-hold market-adjusted return starting three months after issue but not a monthly endpoint convention. The retained construction uses 60 consecutive CRSP monthly periods at offsets +4 through +63 and requires a nonmissing stock and value-weighted market return in every period.

Local SEC_IDHIST contains date-formatted special open-bound sentinels; these were not interpreted as literal history dates. Date-effective identifier matches and resulting offer counts are measured by the fresh native build.
